title: Outlook object check
instructions: Run this in a temporary Python file with classic Outlook open. It creates an unsaved, unaddressed mail item and prints two diagnostic lines. It does not send email.
code:
import win32com.client as win32
mail = win32.GetActiveObject("Outlook.Application").CreateItem(0)
obj = getattr(mail, "_oleobj_", None)
print(type(mail).__name__, type(obj).__name__)
print(hasattr(obj, "GetIDsOfNames"))
